With razor-sharp lyricism and a style that is distinctly his own, Abra has carved out a legendary status within the realm of Filipino hip-hop. Rising from the gritty battlegrounds of FlipTop, he quickly earned acclaim nationwide for his masterful wordplay, rapid-fire delivery, and thought-provoking bars — all of which are skills that seamlessly transitioned from his battles to studio tracks. Over the past decade, Abra has remained a defining figure in the scene, unafraid to challenge norms and elevate the art of Filipino rap with each release.

#Abra’s spot on Billboard Philippines’ Pinoy Hip-Hop Mixtape 2025 is a salute to his enduring influence and the mark he continues to leave on the culture. In a game that often favors trends, Abra has always remained rooted in substance — and that’s what makes him (and his music) timeless.

Read the full story on https://t.co/s4ONxnMByd

Photographed by Excel Panlaque. Art Direction by Nicole Almero. Produced by Mika Cruz. Story by Rome Saenz.

#BBPHPinoyHipHopMixtape
#BillboardPhilippines
#BillboardPH
